bullets.text: The contract for the Rs 264.55 crore Velachery flyover project in Chennai has been officially cancelled, and the office should monitor developments regarding future procurement.
Residents of JJ Nagar in Pazhaverkadu are requesting their Ponneri MLA to visit after struggling for 15 years without basic facilities, and the office should review constituency grievance redressal.
Gummidipoondi has returned to normal after surpassing Delhi in air pollution caused by fuel combustions and road dust, and the office should watch local environmental compliance measures.
Garbage spilling over from a vacant plot has blocked access to three factories in the Ambattur industrial estate, and the office should coordinate clearing the waste with local authorities.
Chief Minister Vijay expressed outrage over alleged corruption involving AI, and the office should monitor political and administrative updates on this matter.
The 6th India Internet Governance Forum 2026 will be held at IIT Madras in Chennai, and the office should prepare for ministerial participation.
Vel Tech TBI hosted the fifth Startup and Investor Summit in Chennai with over 200 startups, and the office should watch regional startup ecosystem growth.
